text:
maya: Rainy weekend incoming. Need one show to binge (<=2 seasons) + one mellow album for background. No crime dramas pls. :cloud_rain:
jon: Ooh. Show: Fleabag if you haven't. Short, hilarious. Album: For Emma, Forever Ago — Bon Iver for cozy vibes.
rachel: If you want something less comedy: The OA is weird but 2 seasons (bit unresolved). Album rec: Dummy by Portishead for moody background.
tune-bot: Suggested playlist: https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLexample — "Rainy Afternoon Mix" ☕
maya: Love Fleabag idea. Anyone up for impromptu watch party Saturday 7pm? :popcorn:
jon: In. I can bring dessert (brownies?).
rachel: Also recommend the film Paterson if you want a gentle, poetic movie instead of a series.
tom: Up for movie too. Also throw High Fidelity (2000) on the list if you want music-heavy film vibes.
maya: quick poll — react with :one: for Fleabag watch party, :two: for OA watch party, :three: for movie night (Paterson / High Fidelity).
jon: :one:
rachel: :three:
maya: tally so far: one=1, three=1 — leaning tie. Let's plan Fleabag ep1 at 7 and decide after. I'll set up the room.
tune-bot: Calendar event created: "Random watch party — Fleabag s1e1" Sat 19:00 (invites: maya, jon, rachel, tom).
maya: shared cozy album link: https://open.spotify.com/album/3dBVyJ7JuOMt4GE9607QIN?si=example — drop in any tracks you want.
rachel: if anyone wants a reading rec after, try The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle for a slow, strange rainy read.
jon: adding Portishead - "Dummy" to the playlist now.
maya: sweet. see you Saturday! :umbrella:
